textContent: Eco Park Kolkata Eco Park Kolkata – An Introduction Eco Park Kolkata is the largest urban park in India and one of the city’s most popular recreational destinations. Spread across nearly 480 acres (194 hectares) in New Town, this beautifully landscaped eco-tourism park combines nature, adventure, culture, recreation, and entertainment in one location. Built around a massive 104-acre water body, Eco Park offers something for everyone. Families enjoy picnics on lush lawns, couples stroll through themed gardens, photographers capture stunning landscapes, and adventure lovers experience cycling, kayaking, zorbing, and other outdoor activities. Whether you are visiting Kolkata for the first time or looking for a relaxing weekend escape, Eco Park deserves a place on your itinerary. History of Eco Park Kolkata Eco Park was developed by the West Bengal Housing Infrastructure Development Corporation (HIDCO) as part of the New Town township project. The park officially opened to the public in December 2012 with the vision of creating a sustainable urban green space while promoting eco-tourism. Since then, it has become one of Kolkata’s most visited attractions, welcoming millions of visitors every year. Unlike traditional city parks, Eco Park integrates environmental conservation with recreation. Large green spaces, themed gardens, wetlands, water bodies, and native vegetation create an environmentally friendly destination that balances leisure with ecological awareness. Architecture and Design Eco Park has been thoughtfully designed into several thematic zones. Highlights include: Massive central lake Landscaped gardens Open lawns Walking and jogging tracks Children’s play areas Musical fountain Amphitheatre Adventure sports zone Butterfly garden Bamboo garden Tea garden Fruit garden Rose garden Japanese garden Wide pedestrian pathways, wooden bridges, cycling tracks, and beautifully maintained landscapes make exploring the park enjoyable throughout the day. Top Attractions Inside Eco Park Kolkata Seven Wonders Park [Image Placeholder: Seven Wonders Replica]Alt Text: Replica of the Eiffel Tower at Seven Wonders Eco Park Kolkata One of Eco Park’s biggest attractions is the Seven Wonders section featuring replicas of: Taj Mahal Eiffel Tower Statue of Liberty Christ the Redeemer Great Wall of China Petra Egyptian Pyramid These replicas make excellent photography spots and are especially popular during the evening when illuminated. Rose Garden Thousands of blooming roses create one of the park’s most colorful sections during winter. Butterfly Garden The butterfly enclosure features flowering plants that attract numerous butterfly species, making it ideal for nature lovers. Japanese Garden Inspired by traditional Japanese landscaping, this peaceful garden includes: Stone pathways Wooden bridges Water features Carefully pruned plants It is among the quietest corners of the park. Bamboo Garden An impressive collection of bamboo varieties creates shaded walkways and offers a refreshing escape from the city. Musical Fountain The evening musical fountain combines colorful lights, synchronized water jets, and music, creating an entertaining experience for visitors. Eco Island Visitors can take a relaxing boat ride to explore the lake surrounding the park while enjoying panoramic views. Adventure Activities at Eco Park Eco Park is much more than a sightseeing destination. Adventure lovers can enjoy: Cycling Boating Kayaking Paddle boating Water cycling Zorbing Roller skating Rifle shooting Archery Speed boating (seasonal) Most activities require separate tickets. Children’s Attractions Families with children particularly enjoy: Children’s play zones Toy train Boating Open green lawns Musical fountain Mini zoo sections Sculpture gardens Eco Park is among the best family-friendly attractions in Kolkata. Timings Eco Park Kolkata Opening Hours Tuesday to Sunday: 12:30 PM – 8:30 PM Tuesday to Sunday: Gate No. 6 Opens at 11:30 AM Monday: Closed for maintenance Some attractions inside the park may have different operating hours. Eco Park Kolkata Entry Fee (Fees are subject to revision.) Category Approximate Fee Entry Ticket ₹30 per person Bicycle Rental Extra Boating Extra Seven Wonders Not Included with park entry (subject to current policy) Adventure Activities Separate charges Children below the prescribed age may receive concessions according to current regulations. Best Time to Visit Eco Park Kolkata The ideal months are: October November December January February Winter offers pleasant temperatures, blooming gardens, and comfortable walking conditions. Evenings are particularly beautiful when decorative lighting transforms the park. How to Reach Eco Park Kolkata By Air The nearest airport is Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport, approximately 12 km away. By Metro The nearest metro connectivity is through the expanding New Town metro corridor. Depending on operational status, visitors can also use nearby stations and continue by taxi. By Train The closest major railway station is Howrah Junction, approximately 20 km away. By Road Eco Park is well connected by: Yellow taxis App-based cabs State buses Private vehicles Paid parking is available. Things to Do at Eco Park Enjoy boating Explore themed gardens Visit Seven Wonders replicas Rent bicycles Photography Nature walks Family picnics Bird watching Watch the musical fountain Experience adventure sports Nearby Attractions Visitors often combine Eco Park with nearby attractions such as: Mother’s Wax Museum Biswa Bangla Gate New Town Coffee House Nazrul Tirtha Science City Nicco Park These attractions can easily be included in a full-day New Town sightseeing itinerary. Visitor Tips and Guidelines Visit during winter for the most pleasant weather. Carry drinking water and sunscreen during summer. Wear comfortable walking shoes. Allocate at least 4–5 hours to explore the park. Keep the park clean by using designated waste bins. Follow safety instructions for boating and adventure activities. Photography is encouraged, but respect any restricted areas. Check weather conditions before planning outdoor activities. Why Visit Eco Park Kolkata? Eco Park offers a unique combination of nature, recreation, and entertainment that appeals to visitors of all ages. Its beautifully landscaped gardens, expansive lake, adventure activities, and iconic Seven Wonders replicas make it an ideal destination for families, couples, photographers, fitness enthusiasts, and tourists. Whether you are seeking a peaceful walk, a fun-filled day outdoors, or a relaxing picnic, Eco Park provides one of the best leisure experiences in Kolkata. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) 1. What is Eco Park Kolkata famous for? Eco Park is famous for being India’s largest urban park, featuring themed gardens, a vast lake, boating, adventure activities, and the popular Seven Wonders replicas. 2. What are the opening hours of Eco Park Kolkata? The park is generally open from 12:30 PM to 8:30 PM (Tuesday–Sunday). It remains closed on Mondays. 3. What is the entry fee for Eco Park Kolkata? The standard entry fee is approximately ₹30 per person, while boating and adventure activities are charged separately. 4. How much time is needed to explore Eco Park? Most visitors spend 4 to 6 hours exploring the park and enjoying its attractions. 5. Is boating available at Eco Park? Yes. Visitors can enjoy paddle boats, rowing boats, water cycling, kayaking, and seasonal speed boating. 6. Which is the best season to visit Eco Park? Winter (October to February) is considered the best time because of the pleasant weather and blooming gardens. 7. Is Eco Park suitable for children? Yes. The park offers play areas, toy train rides, boating, open lawns, and other family-friendly attractions. 8. What are the Seven Wonders at Eco Park? The replicas include the Taj Mahal, Eiffel Tower, Statue of Liberty, Christ the Redeemer, Great Wall of China, Petra, and the Egyptian Pyramid. 9. Can food be purchased inside Eco Park? Yes. Multiple food kiosks and restaurants are available within the park, offering snacks, beverages, and meals. 10. Is parking available at Eco Park? Yes. Paid parking facilities are available for private vehicles. 11. Is Eco Park wheelchair accessible? Most major pathways are broad and relatively accessible, though some attractions may have limited accessibility. 12. Can visitors carry food inside Eco Park? Yes, visitors generally bring packed food for picnics, but they should dispose of waste responsibly and follow park regulations. 13. Is Eco Park worth visiting for tourists? Absolutely. It is one of Kolkata’s premier attractions, offering a blend of natural beauty, recreation, adventure, and family entertainment. 14. Which attractions are located near Eco Park? Nearby attractions include Mother’s Wax Museum, Biswa Bangla Gate, Nazrul Tirtha, and Nicco Park. 15. Can Eco Park be covered in a Kolkata city tour? Yes. Eco Park is often included in customized full-day Kolkata sightseeing tours, particularly when exploring New Town and the eastern part of the city.
